newsitem.title: USA: Transaction sees Q4 below projections.
newsitem.headline: Transaction sees Q4 below projections.

text.p: Transaction Network Services Inc Monday said that it expects fourth quarter results to be below analysts's estimates.
The company said it anticipated fourth quarter revenues of between $13.2 and $13.4 million, or $0.12 and $0.14 per share.
Wall Street had expected the company to earn $0.17 a share in the fourth quarter, according to First Call consensus estimates.

The company attributed the outlook primarily to lower-than-expected transaction volumes throughout the quarter and over the 1996 holiday season and the continuing effect of lower pricing on transaction volume.
Earlier in the year, the company renegotiated several top customer contracts under a new pricing structure which significantly reduced the average price per transaction.
As a result, revenues and earnings were adversely affected in the third quarter and will again be hampered in the fourth quarter, it said.

"All of our customers met or exceeded transaction volume minimums for the quarter," said TNS president John McDonnell. He added, "However, we had expected that several of our larger customers would exceed minimum volume commitments and...didn't. Our internal forecasts were based on that assumption."
